title: From first message to launch in four steps.
subtitle: You see your design before you spend anything.

steps.title: Tell us about your business
steps.text: Message us on WhatsApp or fill a one-minute form: what you do, your current site and your goals.

steps.title: Get your free design
steps.text: Within 48 to 72 hours, depending on complexity, you receive a custom homepage design in Figma. No payment, no obligation.

steps.title: Approve, then we build
steps.text: Pay 30% when your design is approved. We build in one week to one month, with free changes along the way.

steps.title: Launch and grow
steps.text: You see the MVP and pay 30%. The balance is due after 14 days with your site live.
